note: The entry follows Froggatt's 1898 original description (alate); the original is a library OCR text in which 'line' is the English linear unit of the period (1 line about 2.1 mm), kept in the original units.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Dark reddish brown; legs and the basal half of the abdominal segments paler, venter ochre, head darkest, the whole body densely covered with coarse hairs; wings pale rusty brown, the costa and subcosta darker. Length with wings 14 lines (about 29 mm), body length to the end of the abdomen 8 lines (about 17 mm), shoulder width 1.5 lines. Head circular, swollen and widest behind the compound eyes, the top flat, deeply arcuate behind the clypeus, angularly pointed at either side; compound eyes very large, circular and projecting at the sides, the facets rather coarse; ocelli large, kidney-shaped, in front of the compound eyes; antennae 16-segmented, stout and hairy: segment 1 large and cylindrical; segments 2 and 3 smaller; segments 4—15 top-shaped, becoming cylindrical towards the tip with progressively shorter stalks; segment 16 elongate-oval. Clypeus large, broad and rounded, with a faint median suture; clypeal sclerite narrow at the base, swollen at the sides and rounded in front. Maxillary palps stout and hairy. Mandibles large, with 2 curved sharp teeth at the tip, 2 smaller horn-like teeth near the middle and large serrate teeth at the base. Pronotum hairy and broad but narrower than the head, the middle of the anterior margin upturned, the sides oblique towards the posterior margin (which is nearly straight), with a deep impression on either side behind the upturned anterior margin. Wings large, slightly more than 3 times as long as wide, rounded at the tip; shoulder plates small and short, the anterior margin depressed at the transverse suture; costa and subcosta stout and closely applied, reaching the tip of the wing, the base of vein 1 and the lower edge of the subcosta with fine yellow lines; media running in the upper half of the wing, giving off several fine branches from the upper margin towards the subcosta and forked at the tip; submedia parallel to the costa.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Plate 35, figure 12 of the original shows the wing. The original was published as Eutermes magnus, n. sp.
